statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of recurrent syncope and palpitations
There is clinical concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias
CPT code 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The service was ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings over an extended monitoring period
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry was medically necessary
